sources.title: Engineer Research and Development Center tests new cold-weather technology
sources.notes: Official ERDC/USACE article. Used for a bounded technology-signal record; it does not establish fielding, procurement, or operational readiness.

evidence.claim: ERDC/USACE publicly described Project Sandhills demonstrations of autonomous and remotely controlled engineer/construction capabilities in Alaska, including robotic cold-weather operations and autonomous breaching-related technology development.
evidence.claim_cs: ERDC/USACE veřejně popsalo demonstrace Project Sandhills na Aljašce zaměřené na autonomní a dálkově řízené ženijní/stavební schopnosti, včetně robotického provozu v chladném prostředí a vývoje technologií souvisejících s autonomním průchodem překážkami.
evidence.limitations: Official technology-development article; no claim of fielding, procurement award, operational readiness, force-wide adoption, or combat effectiveness.

technology_signals.title: Project Sandhills: cold-weather autonomous engineer and construction technology demonstrations

technology_signals.title_cs: Project Sandhills: demonstrace autonomních ženijních a stavebních technologií v chladném prostředí
technology_signals.summary: U.S. Army ERDC/USACE reported August 2026 testing in Alaska under Project Sandhills involving autonomous and remotely controlled engineer/construction technology for cold-weather operations. The article describes robotics/autonomy experimentation and technology maturation, not fielding or procurement.
technology_signals.summary_en: U.S. Army ERDC/USACE reported August 2026 testing in Alaska under Project Sandhills involving autonomous and remotely controlled engineer/construction technology for cold-weather operations. The article describes robotics/autonomy experimentation and technology maturation, not fielding or procurement.
technology_signals.summary_cs: ERDC/USACE U.S. Army v srpnu 2026 informovalo o testování Project Sandhills na Aljašce s autonomními a dálkově řízenými ženijními/stavebními technologiemi pro chladné prostředí. Jde o experimentování a zrání technologií, nikoli o doložené zavedení nebo akvizici.
technology_signals.organization: U.S. Army Engineer Research and Development Center / U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
technology_signals.organization_cs: U.S. Army Engineer Research and Development Center / U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
technology_signals.limitations_en: The public source supports technology development/testing only. It does not prove fielding, procurement award, operational readiness, unit issue, exact production quantity, or combat effectiveness.
technology_signals.limitations_cs: Veřejný zdroj dokládá pouze vývoj a testování technologie. Neprokazuje zavedení, uzavření akviziční smlouvy, operační připravenost, přidělení jednotkám, přesný počet výroby ani bojovou účinnost.
